title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)
tuition_coverage: Varies by host university (fully waived or subsidized by university top-ups)
duration: Up to 3 years (4 years for 4-year PhD programs via university top-up)
associated_lab_or_professor: Computing / CSE / IE Departments across HK Universities
eligibility_notes: Candidates seeking admission as new full-time PhD students with outstanding academic excellence, research ability, communication skills, and leadership.

title: HKU Presidential PhD Scholarship (HKU-PS)
tuition_coverage: Full tuition fee waiver of HK$42,100 / year
stipend_amount: Up to HK$441,400 in Year 1 (Cash award + PGS + travel subsidy)
associated_lab_or_professor: Computing / CSE / IE Departments across HK Universities
eligibility_notes: Top-tier PhD applicants with exceptional academic track record and research achievements.

university: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
title: HKUST RedBird PhD Award & Postgraduate Studentship (PGS)
tuition_coverage: Tuition scholarship available for HKPFS recipients (HK$42,100/yr)
stipend_amount: HK$40,000 recruitment award + full annual PGS of HK$220,680 (approx HK$18,390/mo)
associated_lab_or_professor: Computing / CSE / IE Departments across HK Universities
eligibility_notes: Outstanding doctoral candidates showing high potential for research impact.

university: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
title: CUHK Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship Scheme
tuition_coverage: Full tuition waiver of HK$42,100 / year for HKPFS recipients
stipend_amount: HK$40,000 - HK$80,000 award + tuition waiver + full studentship
associated_lab_or_professor: Computing / CSE / IE Departments across HK Universities
eligibility_notes: High-caliber students admitted through HKPFS or outstanding departmental nomination.

title: PolyU Presidential PhD Fellowship Scheme (PPPFS)
stipend_amount: Annual cash award of HK$40,000 + full tuition waiver + monthly stipend
associated_lab_or_professor: Computing / CSE / IE Departments across HK Universities
eligibility_notes: High-achieving PhD candidates with demonstrated research innovation.

title: CityU Presidential PhD Scholarship (CBPS) & PGS
stipend_amount: Monthly scholarship of HK$27,600 (HK$331,200/yr) + travel allowance
associated_lab_or_professor: Computing / CSE / IE Departments across HK Universities
eligibility_notes: Outstanding applicants who demonstrate academic excellence and high research potential.

title: HKBU Vice-Chancellor's PhD Fellowship Scheme
tuition_coverage: Full waiver of tuition fee for HKPFS awardees
stipend_amount: HK$27,600 / month + tuition scholarship + research travel fund
associated_lab_or_professor: Computing / CSE / IE Departments across HK Universities
eligibility_notes: Candidates with outstanding academic performance and research promise.

title: Lingnan Full-Time Postgraduate Studentship (PGS) & HKPFS
tuition_coverage: Tuition scholarship available for top-ranked applicants
stipend_amount: Monthly studentship of HK$18,480 (or HK$27,600 for HKPFS awardees)
associated_lab_or_professor: Computing / CSE / IE Departments across HK Universities
eligibility_notes: Full-time PhD students with strong academic merit.

university: The Education University of Hong Kong
title: EdUHK Research Postgraduate Studentship (RPgS)
tuition_coverage: Tuition waivers available for distinguished students
stipend_amount: Monthly studentship of HK$18,200 (or HK$27,600 for HKPFS awardees)
associated_lab_or_professor: Computing / CSE / IE Departments across HK Universities
eligibility_notes: Full-time research postgraduate students with solid bachelor's/master's degrees in relevant disciplines.
